train_corpus_d1 = concat(
    sample(WIKI_TEXTS, int(N_SAMPLES * MIX_RATIO)),           # human 部分
    sample(d0_synthetic_texts, int(N_SAMPLES * (1 - MIX_RATIO)))  # synthetic 部分
)
